value.body: A cloud or DevOps engineer builds and runs the infrastructure that software is deployed on: cloud servers, networks, build and deployment pipelines, and monitoring. Employers include IT services firms, product companies, startups and banks. A typical day involves automating deployments, managing cloud resources, handling alerts, and helping developers ship code safely.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Linux, AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines

items.label: Certifications
items.value: Cloud provider associate-level certifications are widely used

items.label: Tech industry workforce
items.note: Direct employees across IT services, BPM, products and engineering R&D; ~58 lakh in FY2025

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often start in support, system administration or junior DevOps roles in IT services firms. Linux skills, a cloud associate certification and small hands-on projects (deploying an app with a pipeline) help in interviews.

value.title: At a glance
items: Next roles: senior DevOps, site reliability engineer, cloud architect.
Few teams hire pure freshers into DevOps; a support or developer start is common.
